    The universal cover of a finite ray category is countable #

    Paths of a quiver with countably many vertices and arrows are countable (countable_path, via the list of their arrows); hence so are the morphisms of the free groupoid, of the fundamental groupoid, and the objects of the universal cover (countable_cover).
